metadata.reproduction_claim: Arithmetic and decision-rule reanalysis of archived records, not a rerun of training, capture collection or attack fitting.

confidence_and_gates.interval: two-sided 95% Student-t over four paired training-seed contrasts
confidence_and_gates.utility: mean <= 0.10 nats AND upper interval endpoint <= 0.12 nats
confidence_and_gates.gain: mean >= 0.01 nats AND lower interval endpoint > 0
confidence_and_gates.privacy: per required combination qualified in the frozen attack specification: maximum per-seed advantage across the cell's seeds, compared to that combination's privacy limit
confidence_and_gates.not_in_cell_gate: benefit over removed remote is reported separately

power_planning.scope: Prospective planning from exploratory results; exact marginal noncentral-t power conditional on assumed means/SD and normal independent training-seed observations, not empirical confirmation.
cautions: Four exploratory seeds provide fragile means and SD estimates. Half/double SD sensitivity is illustrative, not a variance confidence interval.
Observed plug-in power uses noisy exploratory effects and is not assurance or a guaranteed future success probability.
Specified .01-nat / .01-accuracy-advantage distances are transparent design scenarios, not observed facts or qualification thresholds.
Per-endpoint 80% power does not imply 80% power to reject all 19 cells.
No joint scoped privacy pass is possible with the current 20/24 unqualified instruments.

denominators.note: Windows, matched nulls and candidate scores do not increase the training-seed n.

confidence_and_gates.utility_upper: one-sided 95% upper Student-t limit over three paired training-seed contrasts
confidence_and_gates.gain: mean >=0.01 nats AND all three paired gains strictly >0
confidence_and_gates.privacy: worst seed <=0.02 on every required target with all bindings qualified; missing qualification yields undetermined

units.property: Pearson correlation advantage over matched null (punctuation fraction)
units.structure: five-class accuracy advantage over matched null (next-byte class)

p4.scope_note: No positive complete-transcript defence claim; unevaluated channels remain undetermined.
unevaluated: optimizer state beyond the remote module

e8.threat_model: attacks 1/2/4: PASSIVE observer of h'=h@W with public text+model but no victim labels. attack 3: ORACLE / chosen-plaintext (K exact position-0 pairs) — strictly stronger than the E8 default; the K-curve is the honest security parameter, not a claim about the default model.

denominators.note: Decoder seeds and sessions are not independent training/model replications; key seed material is deliberately not copied.

e8.interpretation: Depth-specific finite attack measurements; not a universal <=3.7% bound or a general K50=0.09H law.

er.scope_note: Only JSON artifacts were collected: summary.json, identity*.json, and session_*/wire_attack_*.json. .pt wire-capture files and w_session_*.key key material were deliberately excluded (gitignored / too large / sensitive). Sessions 2 and 3 of every run contain only the ratchet and static wire_attack JSONs; the base arm is measured once in session_1 by harness design. This matches the previously archived cell er_n16_rtt0_20260810T213415 under collected/invalid/toula/er/.
known_limitations: In shared-key mode the cloud derives W_t itself, so per-epoch freshness protects the wire and logged captures, not cloud RAM.

Two sessions (er_n16_* sess2, er_budget_* sess1) show C_identity=false caused by exactly one flipped token at the same position in both rtt twins (0 ms and 80 ms). Diagnosed as deterministic bf16 borderline-logit rounding across the W round-trip, NOT a ratchet race: the flip is bit-identical across the rtt=0/rtt=80 twin, which a timing race would not reproduce. Affected cells are valid with this known limitation.

runs.limitation: sess2 C_identity=false: single flipped token, same position as rtt80 twin; bf16 borderline-logit rounding over W round-trip, not a ratchet race
